app.name: ScummVM (RPX test)
app.coder: ScummVM Team; Wii U port by Rrhapsod
app.long_description: Native Wii U SDL2 port with Wii Remote IR mouse input and simultaneous GamePad controls. Experimental RPX package: startup through non-Aroma loaders remains unverified. I have not yet tested this Wii Remote candidate on my console. See TESTING.md for controls and requested hardware checks. No games, saves, configuration or MT-32 ROMs are included.
